units: <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Job 35:8">Targ. Job XXXV, 8</cite>.
<cite ref="Rosh Hashanah 28a:3">R. Hash. 28ᵃ</cite> <he>בח׳</he> as an obligation; <he>זמן ח׳</he> the time when one is bound to hear the Shofar; <he>מקום ח׳</he> a place where one is bound.
<cite ref="Sukkah 56a:4">Succ. 56ᵃ</cite> <he>ח׳ דיומא</he> the obligation of the day (to dwell in booths).

<cite ref="Bava Kamma 68a:22">B. Kam. 68ᵃ</cite> <he>חִיּוּבֵיה לאחר יאוש הוא</he> his obligation begins after the object has been despaired of; a. fr.—Pl. <he>חִיּוּבֵי</he>, <cite ref="H00726"><he>חִיּיוּ׳</he></cite>.
